not_scored.why: With the extra budget every request finished normally (80/80 'stop', 0 hit the length cap; the 09-28 attempt had 41/44 length-capped). But reasoning cannot be turned off: event-assign averaged 1,200 completion tokens (Qwen3.6: ~200) and 35 s p50, event-brief 2,275 tokens and 67 s p50, so the run took 125 s per item (~14x Qwen3.6). On the items it did finish, grouping was on par: checkpoint cp1 (8 items) B³ F1 0.804 and cp2 (17 items) 0.790, Link F1 0.75 / 0.75, vs Qwen3.6 on the same checkpoints 0.905 / 0.821 and 0.774 / 0.675. event-brief accepted 19/24.

not_scored.why_zh: 加了输出额度后 80 个请求全部正常结束（0 个被截断；09-28 那次是 44 个里 41 个被截断）。但推理关不掉：event-assign 平均输出 1,200 token（Qwen3.6 约 200）、p50 35 秒，event-brief 2,275 token、p50 67 秒，每条素材 125 秒，约为 Qwen3.6 的 14 倍。已完成部分的分组不差：检查点 cp1（8 条）B³ F1 0.804、cp2（17 条）0.790，同检查点 Qwen3.6 两次为 0.905 / 0.821 和 0.774 / 0.675。

mac.source: bestASR DICTATION_ARCHITECTURE.md §2/§4/§5; IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md (Round 7; speaker freeze line 1444); aggregates of the user's own dictation only

privacy_egress.method: Aggregate-only census of each scale run's Spark organizer.db (read-only): rows the Mac sent (Spark-made segment children excluded), UTF-8 byte counts of the text / segments / persons columns, stored image blobs by MIME, a magic-byte scan of blobs for audio/video (RIFF, OggS, fLaC, ID3, audio/*, video/*), a scan of received segment/person fields for float vectors of length >= 32, and the EXIF tags present in received JPEGs. Script: data/egress.py and data/exiftags.py (copied to the Spark, printed aggregates only). Content was never printed.
limits: The scale harness pastes dictation as text (dictation_as_text) and meetings as transcript files, so these runs never had audio to leak; the census shows what arrived, it does not by itself prove the Mac app never sends audio.

segments_bytes = 0: in these runs no item carried speaker-turn segments; a live meeting item would carry turns (start/end ms, person id, user-given name, text) — never audio or voiceprints (enforced below).
enforcement: Mac wire type RemoteOrganizerItem (Packages/BestASRCore/Sources/BestASRDomain/RemoteOrganizer.swift): 'Audio, embeddings, dictionary entries, and window titles have no fields here.'

Test testPayloadCarriesOnlyAllowedFieldsAndNoPrivateSentinels (Packages/BestASRCore/Tests/BestASRPersistenceTests/RemoteOrganizerPersistenceTests.swift:190) plants sentinel audio tracks, audio chunks, person embeddings, session speaker embeddings and dictionary entries in a synthetic library and asserts none reaches the payload.

Tests testRealLibraryAndUnmarkedRootsNeverStartTheLink / testSeparateDataRootCanNeverPointAtTheRealLibrary / testLaunchArgumentsNeverFallBackToTheRealLibrary keep development runs off the real library.

Spark side (spark/organizer/schemas.py): item kind is a closed set (dictation, meeting_online, meeting_offline, imported_media, text, image, document, file) with no audio payload field; image_b64 only for kind=image, <= 12 MiB; file bytes <= 25 MiB; services bind 127.0.0.1 and are reached only through the user's SSH tunnel.
file-read never decodes audio/video inside archives or attachments (docs/FILE_READ.md §2); the parser subprocess has no network (test_the_parser_process_has_no_network).
